svg.title: Confirmation after an agreement version change
svg.desc: An adjustment creates a new version. The existing owner reads differences and confirms; a new owner accepts again. Results cannot be submitted before confirming the current version.

div.style: color: rgb(40, 52, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(40, 52, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Team leader adjusts agreement
Reason and confirmation deadline required

div.style: color: rgb(40, 52, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
New agreement vN+1
Previously accepted agreement retained
Awaiting confirmation
